name: Meissa
source:
A fortune-teller from Nibiru, the very nation that plunged Avalon into a costly war seven years ago. Meissa possesses a kind heart, a keen intellect, and a dash of mischievous energy. They are in need of a knight to help them protect the ordinary people caught in the middle of the struggle for Nottingham. But will Meissa's kindness and the dangerous secret they harbor spell doom for Meissa and Marion both?

Strengths: Future sight, kindness, scientific knowledge
Flaws: Athletically inept, anxious, a fugitive

Likes: Gardening, experiments, inventions
Dislikes: Human suffering, ignorance, being put in a box

[From [url=https://velvet-cupcake-games.itch.io/made-marion]itch.io[/url]]
